Legal

Accessibility

Paradise should be for everyone

We want every adult visitor to be able to use hashables.com comfortably. This site is built with semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, text alternatives for meaningful images and sufficient color contrast, and it follows your device’s reduced-motion setting by stopping animations and background video.

We work toward the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA. Some content comes from third parties, such as the store finder map and the embedded video, and may not fully meet those guidelines.

Tell us what isn’t working

If something on this site gets in your way, email info@hashables.com with the page and what happened, and we’ll do our best to fix it or get you the information another way.
